preconditions.description: The number of pairs n and the number of colors k are integers between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' if n > k * (k - 1) else (stdout.startswith('YES') and len(pairs) == n and all(1 <= b <= k and 1 <= g <= k and b != g for b, g in pairs) and len(set(pairs)) == n and all(pairs[i][0] != pairs[i+1][0] and pairs[i][1] != pairs[i+1][1] for i in range(n-1)))
postconditions.description: If n exceeds the maximum possible number of valid distinct pairs (k*(k-1)), output NO. Otherwise, output YES followed by n pairs (b_i, g_i) where each color is in [1, k], b_i != g_i, all pairs are distinct, and adjacent pairs differ in both man's and woman's colors.
